name: brand-constructor
description: Brand Constructor - Admin Panel + Constructor для створення брендів

scripts.deploy:unified: node scripts/guard-prod-deploy.mjs && pnpm build:unified && cd deploy/unified && npx wrangler pages deploy public --project-name brand-constructor --branch main
scripts.deploy: node scripts/guard-prod-deploy.mjs && turbo run build && pnpm deploy:worker:production && cd packages/admin && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name brand-constructor
scripts.deploy:constructor: node scripts/guard-prod-deploy.mjs && WIZARD_STANDALONE=true pnpm build:constructor && cd packages/constructor && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name brand-constructor-app --branch main
scripts.deploy:all: node scripts/guard-prod-deploy.mjs && turbo run build && pnpm deploy:worker:production && cd packages/admin && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name brand-constructor && cd ../.. && WIZARD_STANDALONE=true pnpm build:constructor && cd packages/constructor && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name brand-constructor-app --branch main
scripts.deploy:stage:site: VITE_ENVIRONMENT=stage pnpm build:unified && cd deploy/unified && npx wrangler pages deploy public --project-name brand-constructor-stage --branch main
